title: Electoral Intelligence Graph -> synthetic electorate -> comparative mechanism experiment
north_star: Build an empirically anchored artificial electoral society that improves real-time understanding of Morocco 2026, then test whether agent dynamics add out-of-sample value beyond structural baselines.

kill_criteria: Kill or redesign the synthetic-agent layer if calibration exceeds 0.20 pp party-share RMSE or 0.10 pp turnout error.
Reject a network comparison if C and C0 do not use common random numbers or differ in the null arm.
Reject an intervention family if its target/source dose response is non-monotonic without a traceable mechanism.
Treat network reach and electoral materiality as separate findings; do not call reach alone political impact.
Kill the LLM layer if D does not beat B and C on a frozen out-of-sample metric or is prompt/model unstable.
Never publish a national 2026 forecast from this four-constituency pilot.

rabat-ocean.notes: Synthetic urbanity assumption; aggregate turnout and party shares are recalibrated to the real 2021 table.

larache.notes: Synthetic mixed-territory assumption; not a local demographic estimate.

fes-sud.notes: Synthetic urbanity assumption; denominator conflict remains recorded in the source layer.

oued-eddahab.notes: Synthetic urbanity assumption; not a local demographic estimate.

hypotheses.statement: Before any event, weighted agents must aggregate back to each constituency's observed 2021 turnout and party shares within the preregistered numerical tolerance.
Network interactions without an injected event must not create a politically meaningful turnout drift or an unexplained seat narrative.
When a documented local-network transfer mechanism is injected, C may differ from B through diffusion; the difference must be measurable and traceable, not merely narrated.
AgentSociety 2 cognition is retained only if replayable delegate outputs improve a frozen out-of-sample metric versus B and C.

interventions.label: Uniform turnout contraction
interventions.falsification_question: Does a uniform turnout-only shock create systematic party directionality? If yes, inspect unjustified synthetic correlations.

interventions.label: Uniform turnout expansion
interventions.falsification_question: Does a uniform turnout-only shock create systematic party directionality? If yes, inspect unjustified synthetic correlations.

interventions.label: Larache candidate-network portability
interventions.falsification_question: At what synthetic portability dose, if any, does PAM enter the four-seat set; is the response monotonic?

interventions.label: Oued Eddahab local-network transfer
interventions.falsification_question: At what synthetic portability dose, if any, does PAM enter the two-seat set; is the response monotonic?

interventions.label: Rabat-Ocean non-partisan campaign salience
interventions.falsification_question: Does high salience amplify variance and exposure cascades without manufacturing a directional party effect?

interventions.label: Synthetic high-diffusion network positive control
interventions.falsification_question: Can the network implementation produce traceable extra reach and a monotonic target-party response when deliberately stressed?

arms.label: Null / reconstruction control
arms.description: No public event is injected. This arm measures calibration, Monte Carlo drift and whether the network invents a story by itself.

arms.label: Uniform participation contraction
arms.description: A neutral turnout-only contraction is applied identically to all parties and all four pilot constituencies.

arms.label: Uniform participation expansion
arms.description: A neutral turnout-only expansion is applied identically to all parties and all four pilot constituencies.

arms.label: Larache network portability range
arms.description: Tests a bounded 10-40% synthetic portability range from the 2021 RNI anchor to PAM after the documented 2026 candidate reconfiguration. The range is not an empirical estimate.

arms.label: Oued Eddahab network portability range
arms.description: Tests a bounded 10-40% synthetic portability range from the 2021 Istiqlal anchor to PAM following the documented party switch. The range is not an empirical estimate.

arms.label: Rabat-Ocean high-salience stress test
arms.description: Raises non-partisan campaign attention and diffusion in the tightest cutoff of the micro-panel without assigning any party a direct advantage.

arms.label: Network positive control — synthetic stress
arms.description: Deliberately high-diffusion positive control used only to validate causal plumbing and dose response. It is not a plausible 2026 scenario.
arms.purpose: positive control for network reach and monotonicity

safety_boundary.allowed: aggregate neutral mechanism analysis and falsifiable counterfactuals

amendments.timing: after engineering smoke run; before the frozen 96-run evidentiary execution
amendments.change: Pair direct-exposure and ballot-integration random streams between C and C0; isolate network-only streams.
amendments.reason: The smoke audit showed that sharing only a seed does not guarantee a causal network ablation when RNG streams diverge.
amendments.anti_p_hacking_note: The earlier quick run is retained as an engineering artifact and is not used as evidence.

amendments.change: Add a clearly synthetic high-diffusion positive-control arm and separate reach from substantive materiality.
amendments.reason: A plumbing test should not be conflated with a claim about plausible 2026 effect size.
amendments.anti_p_hacking_note: The positive control cannot be interpreted as a forecast or empirical voter-transfer estimate.

amendments.timing: after engineering smoke audit; before the frozen 96-run evidentiary execution
amendments.change: Separate bounded current-prior findings from the deliberately synthetic high-diffusion positive control in reach, dose-response and materiality gates.
amendments.reason: A positive-control effect validates causal plumbing but cannot be used to claim that current 2026 priors produce a material electoral increment.
amendments.anti_p_hacking_note: The current-prior materiality threshold remains unchanged at 0.05 pp and is explicitly non-blocking; failure is retained as a scientific result.

analysis_plan.paired_ablation: C and C0 receive identical populations, parameters, direct-exposure draws and aggregate ballot integration; only network streams differ.
analysis_plan.materiality_threshold: 0.05 percentage point mean target-party share lift for C minus C0
analysis_plan.forecast_boundary: full 92-local plus 12-regional replay and frozen out-of-sample scoring remain mandatory
analysis_plan.current_prior_vs_positive_control: Current-prior arms and the synthetic positive control are scored in separate gates and separate headline findings.
